Task:
Repo: /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite. React UI under ui/. Work ONLY on frontend files under ui/src/remote/ (and its test file).

GOAL: When a phone browser opens the remote web app it must NOT show a flat "Active Terminals" list. It must mirror the desktop app navigation: Projects → Worktrees → Terminals hierarchy, and tapping a terminal attaches to the EXISTING desktop session (attach flow already works).

Files:
- ui/src/remote/RemoteApp.tsx
- ui/src/remote/RemoteSessionList.tsx (replace content with the new hierarchy view; may rename component semantics but keep the file)
- ui/src/remote/RemoteUI.test.tsx (update/add tests)
- Do NOT touch RemoteTerminal.tsx attach logic, PairingPage.tsx, or anything outside ui/src/remote/.

API CONTRACT (backend is being updated in parallel — code against this shape):
- GET `/api/v1/workspace/state?token=...` returns JSON:
  { projects: [{ workspaceId: string, repoRoot: string }],
    activeWorkspaceId: string,
    worktrees: [{ path: string, head: string, branch: string | null, bare: bool, detached: bool }],
    sessions: [{ sessionId: string, title: string | null, workspaceId: string | null, worktreeLabel: string | null, running: bool }] }
  (serde camelCase confirmed in src-tauri/src/remote/protocol.rs).
- Sessions map into the hierarchy by workspaceId + worktreeLabel. A session whose worktreeLabel is null goes under a synthetic "Ungrouped" group inside its project (or an "Unassigned" section if workspaceId is also null).

MUST DO:
1. RemoteApp.tsx: fetch `/api/v1/workspace/state` instead of `/api/v1/sessions`. Keep token handling, #pair= fragment flow, disconnect button exactly as-is. Keep loadSessions-equivalent refresh function.
2. Build the hierarchy view (in RemoteSessionList.tsx): accordion of projects (tap toggles expand/collapse; active project expanded by default using activeWorkspaceId), each project lists its worktrees (label = session worktreeLabel if present else branch short name from worktree.branch stripped of refs/heads/, else last path segment), each worktree row shows its terminals count and expands/taps through to show terminal rows; tapping a terminal calls onSelect(sessionId) which mounts the existing RemoteTerminal. Include a Refresh action like today. Empty states: no projects → message telling user to open the desktop app; worktree with no terminals → subtle placeholder row.
3. Visual language: reuse the existing dark theme classes already present in RemoteSessionList.tsx (bg-neutral-950, #12141a panels, blue accents, lucide-react icons). Mobile-first single column, touch targets >= 44px, chevron affordances for accordions.
4. DISPLAY RULE (hard requirement): never render local absolute paths (repoRoot/path) in the UI. Show branch names or derived slugs only. Strip `refs/heads/` prefix from branches.
5. Tests in RemoteUI.test.tsx (vitest, follow existing patterns in that file): (a) renders projects→worktrees→terminals hierarchy from a mocked workspace/state payload; (b) tapping a terminal triggers onSelect with the right sessionId; (c) session with null worktreeLabel lands in the Ungrouped group; (d) no absolute paths appear in rendered text.

SUCCESS CRITERIA:
- `cd ui && bun run test -- src/remote` passes (exit 0). If the script form differs use `cd ui && bunx vitest run src/remote --maxWorkers=1`.
- `cd ui && bun run build` type-checks clean (tsc).
Report changed files and exact commands + results.
